items.title: Roy Haynes — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I just had Liza and another record. I didn’t see him at all.

ctx.x: I just had Liza and another record. I didn’t see him at all. My brother would come back from the Savoy Ballroom when they would have the battle of the bands and tell me everything about him. So it was like seeing him.
When I said, Papa Jo, you said, he didn’t know it back then. Why . . .?
